items.title: Google Cloud rolls out Gemini for healthcare
items.excerpt: Google launched Gemini for healthcare, an agentic AI platform built with clinical and health-plan leaders and designed to support HIPAA compliance; US preview partners include Northwell, HCA and Optum.

items.title: Doximity expands clinical AI footprint to more than 190 health systems
items.excerpt: More than 190 health systems have now purchased Doximity's clinical AI suite, up from 165 last quarter, as enterprise deployments of its clinician AI tools expand. (Earnings-adjacent deployment count; weaker.)

items.title: Voice changes may detect worsening heart failure weeks before other symptoms appear
items.excerpt: An AI-powered voice analysis system presented at AHA 2026 flagged worsening heart failure weeks before other symptoms and was much more accurate than the current standard of care. (Cardiology, but remote-monitoring voice AI rather than imaging.)

items.title: Large language models show potential in MRI protocoling
items.excerpt: A new analysis finds LLMs perform on par with radiologists at selecting the most appropriate MRI protocol for patients.

items.title: Synthetic data to lower barriers towards equitable artificial intelligence in rapid diagnostic test interpretation
items.excerpt: SynSight generates synthetic rapid-diagnostic-test images so machine-learning readers of RDTs can be trained without large, proprietary, costly real-world image libraries, aiming at equitable point-of-care diagnosis.

items.title: Collaborative generalist-specialist AI for safe worklist deprioritization of non-contrast brain CT
items.excerpt: A generalist-plus-specialist AI system is designed to safely deprioritize normal non-contrast brain CT scans on radiology worklists, targeting high sensitivity and negative predictive value across common and rare findings.

items.title: Multi-sequence MRI-based radiomics model for predicting radiotherapy response in thyroid eye disease
items.excerpt: A multi-sequence MRI radiomics model predicts which thyroid eye disease patients will respond to orbital radiotherapy, whose effect varies widely across patients — a treatment-planning use of imaging AI.

items.title: AI 재활 앱, 오십견 환자 어깨 외회전 개선 효과 확인
items.excerpt: 국내 교수팀이 AI 기반 재활 앱을 활용한 운동이 오십견 환자의 어깨 외회전 운동 범위와 삶의 질 개선에 도움이 된다는 연구 결과를 내놨다.

items.title: AI로 항생제 처방 지원 시스템 구축한다! — 한림대강남성심병원
items.excerpt: 한림대강남성심병원이 감염 위험을 예측하고 검사 결과가 나오기 전 의료진의 항생제 선택을 돕는 병원 맞춤형 AI 처방 지원 시스템 구축에 나섰다(항생제 적정사용·AMR 대응).

items.title: 의정갈등 속 업무 혼선 AI로…해운대백병원 간호국이 이끈 변화
items.excerpt: 해운대백병원 간호국이 약 1,500명 간호인력 관리, 신규 간호사 채용·교육에 AI를 쓰고, 인턴 복귀 후 PA 간호사 업무분장 혼선을 AI 챗봇으로 줄인 사례.

items.title: "환자 눈 보는 동안 기록은 AI가"…33년차 외과의가 만든 '왕진 도구'
items.excerpt: 왕진연구소(집으로의원) 김주형 대표가 방문진료 중 대화를 SOAP 기록 초안으로 정리하는 AI 기능을 개발했다; 회사 자체 측정에서 주 50건 왕진 의사의 행정 시간이 주 12.5시간에서 1.7시간으로 줄었다.

items.title: Lunit wins Saudi National Guard healthcare AI imaging deal
items.excerpt: Lunit will supply Lunit Insight CXR and MMG chest x-ray and mammography AI to Saudi Arabia's Ministry of National Guard Health Affairs, integrated into PACS across its hospitals.

items.title: AI improves trainee doctors' ear disease diagnostic accuracy by 32.2 percentage points: AMC
items.excerpt: Asan Medical Center's AI model, trained on 7,335 ear endoscopy images, raised junior trainees' accuracy in telling chronic otitis media from otitis media with effusion from 54.4% to 86.6%.

items.title: Pediatric emergency specialist turns to AI as staffing fears deepen
items.excerpt: A Samsung Medical Center pediatric emergency specialist built an AI agent that gathers information from parents before they meet staff, plus a validation framework, in response to pediatric ER staffing shortages.

items.title: OpenAI's head of health talks helping patients take action
items.excerpt: OpenAI health lead Nate Gross says ChatGPT Health's next phase could move people 'from better answers with context to really empowered actions'. (Interview; registration wall.)

items.title: FDA seeks input on telesurgery, autonomous robotics
items.excerpt: FDA's CDRH released a discussion paper on benefit-risk for robotic medical devices with autonomous or remote teleoperation capabilities (docket FDA-2026-N-13135, comments due Jan. 5, 2027; workshop Dec. 2-3). Paper itself speaks of autonomy, not AI by name.

items.title: Randomized Evaluation of an Autoimmune Disease Prediction Model — AURA (AUtoimmune Risk Assessment)
items.excerpt: NEJM AI original article reporting a randomized evaluation of AURA, an autoimmune disease risk-prediction model. (Page Cloudflare-gated; date from Crossref created; body not verified.)

items.title: Artificial Intelligence Use in Interventional Clinical Trials Registered on ClinicalTrials.gov
items.excerpt: Cross-sectional study of how AI is used in interventional clinical trials registered on ClinicalTrials.gov since 2022. (Cloudflare-gated; date from Crossref created.)

items.title: AI: ChatGPT makers are sued by parents over daughter's death
items.excerpt: BMJ news: parents sue OpenAI over their daughter's death, adding to liability cases over chatbot health/mental-health conversations. (Page gated; date from Crossref created; body not verified.)

items.title: AI's health advice can be accurate and still make us sicker
items.excerpt: Opinion: researchers argue health-AI benchmarks should test behavioral effects, because 'even a factually accurate health message can change behavior in ways that make people less healthy'. (Opinion; patient-safety angle.)

items.title: New Campaign Wants AI Applications To Look Beyond Speed
items.excerpt: Healthcare leaders launch a campaign pushing AI-native redesign of care rather than merely speeding up broken administrative workflows. (Advocacy; weak.)

items.title: The Ohio State University and Microsoft announce five-year strategic partnership across clinical care, education and research
items.excerpt: Ohio State Wexner Medical Center and Microsoft sign a five-year partnership to deploy clinical AI in care delivery, medical education and research. (Partnership press release; check concrete deployments.)

items.title: GEHC adds lung, aortic stenosis AI tools to Vscan Air
items.excerpt: GE HealthCare added lung and aortic stenosis AI tools to its Vscan Air handheld ultrasound; both have FDA 510(k) clearance and the CE mark (point-of-care ultrasound AI).

items.title: HOPPR releases whole-body MSK x-ray report drafting model
items.excerpt: HOPPR released a foundation model that drafts findings text for musculoskeletal radiographs across the whole body using up to three views per study.

items.title: Quibim's prostate MRI AI joins Microsoft imaging AI network
items.excerpt: Quibim's QP-Prostate MRI AI is now available to North American healthcare organizations through Microsoft's Precision Imaging Network. (Distribution deal; weaker.)

items.title: Equipping healthcare professionals with practical AI skills
items.excerpt: Google launched a Google AI for Healthcare Professionals Certificate, built by Google clinicians, to teach practical AI skills such as patient prioritization (medical education).
